P&H High Court Rules State Cannot Claim Adverse Possession Over Citizen Land

The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ruled that the state cannot claim adverse possession over land belonging to its citizens. The court directed that if the government wishes to use private land, it must acquire it through proper legal channels and provide compensation to the landowners. This decision clarifies the rights of citizens regarding their property and limits the state's ability to take possession without due process. The ruling emphasizes the necessity of fair acquisition and compensation for land used by the government.
